nougatSpec.description: The text parser spec for pdfplumber.

pageImageKwargs.description:
Keyword arguments for page_to_image method in pdfplumber.
Available arguments:
- resolution: The desired number pixels per inch.
- width: The desired image width in pixels.
- height: The desired image width in pixels. Default is determined by resolution. Type: int.
- antialias: Whether to use antialiasing when creating the image. Setting to true creates images with less-jagged text and graphics, but with larger file sizes.
See {@link https://github.com/jsvine/pdfplumber} for more details.

pypdf2OverlapRatio.description: The ratio of overlap when extracting text from crop boxes.

postProcessorThresholdLow.description: The lower threshold for parser's post processor. This is used when adding neighbor page contents for structure completeness.

postProcessorThresholdHigh.description:
The higher threshold for parser's post processor. This is used when adding neighbor page contents for structure completeness
when the page does not have an appropriate ending.
